name: How do metal roofs compare to asphalt shingles in terms of longevity?

mainEntity.name: How do metal roofs compare to asphalt shingles in terms of longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofs typically offer a significantly longer lifespan than traditional asphalt shingles, often lasting 40-70 years or more compared to 15-30 years for shingles. This extended durability is a key advantage of metal roofing, reducing the frequency of replacement and associated costs over the home's lifetime. The material's resistance to extreme weather also contributes to its longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs last 40-70+ years, far exceeding asphalt shingles' 15-30 year lifespan.
